latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of video-help: fast, AI-powered video editing and export.

- Upload MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos up to 500MB for quick edits and 1080p exports.
- Instantly connects to a cloud video editing API (automatic token/session management).
- Supports trimming pauses, adding subtitles, aspect ratio changes, text overlays, and audio tracks via keywords.
- Download 1080p MP4 files in 1–2 minutes; free tier included.
- Clear error messages and workflow summaries provided throughout editing and export.
